name: How long does it take to build a playroom addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a playroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a playroom addition project typically ranges from 2 to 6 months, from initial design to final construction. This duration can be influenced by factors such as the complexity of the design, lead times for materials, and the permitting process in your specific city within our service areas like Berkeley or Alameda. We work to establish a clear project schedule upfront, and consistent communication helps manage expectations during construction. Unforeseen structural issues in existing homes can also extend the timeline.
